Detector: stop scoring text no visitor can see at capture (curtain footers, pass-through overlays, map markers, consent bars, 1px text) (#1040) * Text set at 1px or less is not painted for text rules uni-hannover.de hides a Mastodon link with an inline font-size: 1px in a static 9x1 box nothing clips. The Text gate's font-size test was strictly under 1px, so undersized-ui-text scored it as 1px functional text. A glyph a pixel tall is a dot; the threshold is now 1px or less, and the occlusion probe's own-text test reads the same predicate. Co-Authored-By: Claude Code Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FTbrWaYuBu9QB8gE99M2xi * numbered-section-labels skips a label or heading nobody sees juskoe.vercel.app sets its small "01" to "03" labels in an md:hidden block, at display: none on desktop, beside headings that show. The collector had no paint gate; it now asks the Text gate of both the label and the heading, as the kicker collector does. Two older unit tests gain the rects a measured page would have. Co-Authored-By: Claude Code Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FTbrWaYuBu9QB8gE99M2xi * body-text-viewport-edge skips text in a fixed bar klimaschutz-niedersachsen.de and lockheedmartin.com set consent copy in a

inside a position: fixed bar that runs to the window's sides. The rule already exempts an element that is itself fixed; it now also skips text under a fixed ancestor shorter than half the viewport. A window-tall fixed layer (how a smooth-scroll library holds the page), an unmeasured one, and a sticky ancestor keep the finding. Co-Authored-By: Claude Code Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FTbrWaYuBu9QB8gE99M2xi * A box is a script scroll frame only when its flow runs past it chefsspecial.app's Mapbox box is 800px tall, hides its overflow, and records a scroll height of 1,626 from restaurant markers placed below its edge. is_script_scroll_frame took that for a smooth-scroll wrapper and kept the markers below the map, so their count badges reported low contrast. A frame now also needs a descendant in its own flow (reached without passing an absolute or fixed box) that runs past its bottom. A box the capture did not measure, text the frame holds of its own, or a walk past 2,000 descendants keeps the frame. Co-Authored-By: Claude Code Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FTbrWaYuBu9QB8gE99M2xi * text-occlusion skips a curtain footer and a graphic under pass-through text runlatent.ai's footer is position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 0 under a main at z-index 1 with an opaque fill: a curtain the page uncovers as it scrolls away. Every probe over the footer's links answered the page's headings, and the stack showed the footer under main, but the burial test only counted layers that hold the victim, so 20 findings read the links as covered by the headings. A victim whose nearest sticky or fixed ancestor sets a numeric z-index of 0 or below now skips a point where a box outside that layer, with a fill of 0.95 alpha or more, lies between the answer and the victim in the stack, but only when no probe over any text in that layer answers inside it. z-index auto, an unrecorded one, one unanswered probe, or one probe the layer answers keeps every finding. boardlab.dev's canvas hint panel is pointer-events: none over a circuit SVG, so the probe passes through its text to the drawing below. The opaque box branch already refused to rank a box under such text; a graphic answer now does too. An SVG text element still overlaps. Co-Authored-By: Claude Code Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FTbrWaYuBu9QB8gE99M2xi * skipped-heading reads a heading's text without script or style source munsifdaily.in writes the Islamic date into an h5 with an inline
